rows.why: #296 smoke and smoke-census: 40 true proofs withheld beside the false ones, each named in changes.json; ADR 1133 recovered 21 (Reflect.apply 20: Reflect is a hazard only for writing members and key readers; the then on an object literal 1: a contained hook is no delivery hazard). Still owed: an uninstalled package (unread-module) 12, JSON.stringify with a replacer (key-reader) 5, a literal javascript: URL 2 (docs/open-work.md, ADR 1125 owed and N4). The shadow-delivery owner bit (5 smoke-census programs, not in the proved ledger) was recovered by ADR 1139.

bundle j smoke-census: mx-sync-node-received-async-flw-owned-eval-memo-direct-none (a proved-ledger entry; its effect twin moves alike but is no ledger entry), an SC7002 violation Chrome confirms, withheld because the program's `eval` may attach a shadow root and dispatch from an effect's apply (apply_dispatch_into_shadow_possible fails closed on code built from a string). Recovered when a literal eval string is read as the code it is (no shadow root, no dispatch).

bundle s smoke-census: 33 proved mx-census programs (context-not-found in dny-*, evt-* and pos-handler-owner contexts), each an SC4002 violation Chrome confirms (CONTEXT_NOT_FOUND), withheld by owner-check-throws-first (a context read in a JSX handler whose owner varies by caller or may be null). Recovered when an order proof shows that a run at mount, before the handler can be delivered, is the first (docs/open-work.md, ADR 1177). A 34th program, dny-change-checkbox-retyped, moves alike and is in no ledger. Not built (ADR 1192 released, 2026-11-23): in each program the owned run is a DOM side effect of code in `Later`'s body (a `.click()` or `dispatchEvent`, but mostly a removal, move, disable, popover change or disposal that fires blur, beforetoggle, change or load synchronously) on an element found by `document.querySelector('[data-act="b1"]')`. The checker has no element identity: a handler's owner is a seed (OWNED and UNOWNED wherever a synchronous dispatch exists), and no edge says which call delivers which handler's event. A proof would resolve selector strings to JSX elements (name matching, which invariant 3 forbids; uniqueness in the live DOM is not provable from the source) and model each delivery mechanism and the focus or popover state before it.
